question: Who among the following won the FIFA Best Men's Player award for the second consecutive year in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Robert Lewandowski**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bayern Munich's Polish striker Robert Lewandowski has won the FIFA Best Men's Player award for 2021.
 
• Barcelona's Spanish midfielder Alexia Putellas won the FIFA Best Women's Player prize.
 
• They were awarded on 17 January 2022.
 
• Chile and Olympique Lyonnais’ Christiane Endler was named The Best Women’s Goalkeeper.
 
• The Puskas Award for Best Goal of the Year was won by Argentine Erik Lamela.
 
• Chelsea won both the awards for the best coach, with Thomas Tuchel winning the men's award and Emma Hayes named the best women's coach.
